s0101.literal: An edict ordered the Liaoyang branch secretariat to verify and grant provisions.
s0101.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Liaoyang branch secretariat to verify and grant provisions.

s0102.literal: Pingshan, Zhending, and Zaoqiang two counties suffered drought; Lingshou and Yuanshi two counties suffered heavy rain and hail; their rents were all remitted.
s0102.idiomatic: Pingshan, Zhending, and Zaoqiang two counties suffered drought; Lingshou and Yuanshi two counties suffered heavy rain and hail; their rents were all remitted.

s0103.literal: On dingyou day two thousand five hundred ingots of notes were used to relieve the impoverished relay-station households from Changping to Shangdu.
s0103.idiomatic: On dingyou day 2,500 ingots of notes were used to relieve the impoverished relay-station households from Changping to Shangdu.

s0104.literal: Dingxing relay-station households suffered famine; thirty days' grain was granted.
s0104.idiomatic: Dingxing relay-station households suffered famine; 30 days' grain was granted.

s0105.literal: On jihai day the impoverished and sick commoners on the register in Dadu Route, numbering two thousand eight hundred thirty-seven persons, were investigated; two hundred shi of grain was issued to relieve them.
s0105.idiomatic: On jihai day the impoverished and sick commoners on the register in Dadu Route, numbering 2,837 persons, were investigated; 200 shi of grain was issued to relieve them.

s0106.literal: On gengzi day Hedan again raided Haiyang.
s0106.idiomatic: On gengzi day Hedan again raided Haiyang.

s0107.literal: The Anhe Office was re-established, at rank six negative.
s0107.idiomatic: The Anhe Office was re-established, at rank six negative.

s0108.literal: Summer, fifth month, on yisi day the Prince of Qin's treasury office was abolished and its seal confiscated.
s0108.idiomatic: Summer, fifth month, on yisi day the Prince of Qin's treasury office was abolished and its seal confiscated.

s0109.literal: Unregistered persons' miscellaneous livestock, money, and silks in Jiangnan were registered.
s0109.idiomatic: Unregistered persons' miscellaneous livestock, money, and silks in Jiangnan were registered.

s0111.literal: On wushen day Jiangxi branch secretariat Guan Rude and Jiangxi branch privy council Yuedimishi joined forces to suppress the rebel bandit Zhong Mingliang; Mingliang surrendered, and an edict ordered him bound and sent to court, but Rude and the others detained him and did not send him; Mingliang again led crowds to raid Ganzhou.
s0111.idiomatic: On wushen day Jiangxi branch secretariat Guan Rude and Jiangxi branch privy council Yuedimishi joined forces to suppress the rebel bandit Zhong Mingliang; Mingliang surrendered, and an edict ordered him bound and sent to court, but Rude and the others detained him and did not send him; Mingliang again led crowds to raid Ganzhou.

s0112.literal: The privy council, because Rude and others defied the edict and released the bandits, requested they be investigated; this was approved.
s0112.idiomatic: The privy council, because Rude and others defied the edict and released the bandits, requested they be investigated; this was approved.

s0113.literal: An edict abolished the Jiangxi branch privy council.
s0113.idiomatic: An edict abolished the Jiangxi branch privy council.

s0114.literal: On gengxu day frost at Shaanxi's South Market garrison-farm colony killed the crops; its rent was remitted.
s0114.idiomatic: On gengxu day frost at Shaanxi's South Market garrison-farm colony killed the crops; its rent was remitted.

s0115.literal: On renzi day grain was granted to the armies of Princes Temür and others, seventeen thousand one hundred men in all: one man with one follower received five shi; two men with one follower received seven shi five dou.
s0115.idiomatic: On renzi day grain was granted to the armies of Princes Temür and others, 17,100 men in all: one man with one follower received 5 shi; two men with one follower received 7.5 shi.

s0116.literal: On bingchen day grain was issued to relieve the Imperial Canal boat households.
s0116.idiomatic: On bingchen day grain was issued to relieve the Imperial Canal boat households.

s0117.literal: Various tribal peoples of Xuzhou and other places presented eight hundred rain felts as tribute.
s0117.idiomatic: Various tribal peoples of Xuzhou and other places presented 800 rain felts as tribute.

s0118.literal: On wuwu day the Jiangxi branch secretariat was moved to Jizhou to facilitate capturing bandits.
s0118.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Jiangxi branch secretariat was moved to Jizhou to facilitate capturing bandits.

s0119.literal: The ministry secretariat dispatched men to inspect Yunnan's silver mines; four thousand forty-eight liang of silver was obtained.
s0119.idiomatic: The ministry secretariat dispatched men to inspect Yunnan's silver mines; 4,048 liang of silver was obtained.

s0120.literal: Memorial reported establishing a silver-field official, at rank seven negative.
s0120.idiomatic: Memorial reported establishing a silver-field official, at rank seven negative.

s0121.literal: One thousand one hundred fifteen households of Chulu and others suffered famine; sixty days' grain was granted.
s0121.idiomatic: 1,115 households of Chulu and others suffered famine; 60 days' grain was granted.

s0122.literal: On guihai day an edict ordered: "When commoners of princely fiefs have lawsuits, the prince's tutor and the appointed supervisory prefect jointly hear them; where there is no supervisory prefect, the prince's tutor alone decides.
s0122.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict ordered, "When commoners of princely fiefs have lawsuits, the prince's tutor and the appointed supervisory prefect jointly hear them; where there is no supervisory prefect, the prince's tutor alone decides.

s0123.literal: " Pingluan had fifteen thousand four hundred sixty-five famine-stricken households; five thousand shi of grain was issued for relief.
s0123.idiomatic: Pingluan had 15,465 famine-stricken households; 5,000 shi of grain was issued for relief.

s0124.literal: Bandits Hu Fa and Rao Bicheng of Jixi, Huizhou, were executed.
s0124.idiomatic: Bandits Hu Fa and Rao Bicheng of Jixi, Huizhou, were executed.

s0125.literal: On yichou day the moon encroached upon Saturn.
s0125.idiomatic: On yichou day the moon encroached upon Saturn.

s0126.literal: On bingyin day the Fengchen Treasury was abolished.
s0126.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Fengchen Treasury was abolished.

s0127.literal: Jiangxi branch ministry secretariat associate administrator Yang Wencan was transferred to left vice chancellor; Wencan did not take office for over a year, and an edict ordered Wailadai to replace him.
s0127.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch ministry secretariat associate administrator Yang Wencan was transferred to left vice chancellor; Wencan did not take office for over a year, and an edict ordered Wailadai to replace him.

s0128.literal: When Wailadai arrived, Wencan resumed handling affairs; Sangge then memorialized that Wencan be promoted to right vice chancellor.
s0128.idiomatic: When Wailadai arrived, Wencan resumed handling affairs; Sangge then memorialized that Wencan be promoted to right vice chancellor.

s0129.literal: Jiangxi branch secretariat said: "In Ji, Gan, Hunan, Guangdong, and Fujian, because bows and arrows are forbidden, bandits have increased; we request that following the inner prefecture precedent, patrol troops be permitted to carry bows and arrows.
s0129.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch secretariat said, "In Ji, Gan, Hunan, Guangdong, and Fujian, because bows and arrows are forbidden, bandits have increased; we request that following the inner prefecture precedent, patrol troops be permitted to carry bows and arrows.

s0131.literal: On jisi day the Yunnan branch censorate was established.
s0131.idiomatic: On jisi day the Yunnan branch censorate was established.

s0132.literal: Cherithemur's Jurchen, Goryeo, Khitan, and Han troops were ordered, aside from paying land tax, to be exempt from all other corvée.
s0132.idiomatic: Cherithemur's Jurchen, Goryeo, Khitan, and Han troops were ordered, aside from paying land tax, to be exempt from all other corvée.

s0133.literal: Jiangyin suffered great flood; ten thousand seven hundred ninety shi of field rent was remitted.
s0133.idiomatic: Jiangyin suffered great flood; 10,790 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0134.literal: On gengwu day the prince's tutor for Prince Yezhilie was re-established, at rank four positive.
s0134.idiomatic: On gengwu day the prince's tutor for Prince Yezhilie was re-established, at rank four positive.

s0135.literal: The Guangbei and other garrison-farm colonies of the Directorate of Imperial Delicacies suffered great flood; their rent was remitted.
s0135.idiomatic: The Guangbei and other garrison-farm colonies of the Directorate of Imperial Delicacies suffered great flood; their rent was remitted.

s0136.literal: The people of Boyao lacked food; Sadishimil was ordered to transport one thousand shi of rice with five hundred carts to relieve them.
s0136.idiomatic: The people of Boyao lacked food; Sadishimil was ordered to transport 1,000 shi of rice with 500 carts to relieve them.

s0137.literal: Bandits Lü Chong'er, Yang Yuanliu, and others of Yongkang and Dongyang in Wuzhou and Jinyun in Chuzhou rebelled; Zhedong pacification commissioner Shi Bi captured and executed them.
s0137.idiomatic: Bandits Lü Chong'er, Yang Yuanliu, and others of Yongkang and Dongyang in Wuzhou and Jinyun in Chuzhou rebelled; Zhedong pacification commissioner Shi Bi captured and executed them.

s0138.literal: Bandit Chen Qishi of Nan'an, Quanzhou, rebelled; he was suppressed.
s0138.idiomatic: Bandit Chen Qishi of Nan'an, Quanzhou, rebelled; he was suppressed.

s0139.literal: Household registration of yin-yang practitioners throughout the realm was conducted; instructors were established in each route, and one skilled practitioner was sent as tribute annually from each.
s0139.idiomatic: Household registration of yin-yang practitioners throughout the realm was conducted; instructors were established in each route, and one skilled practitioner was sent as tribute annually from each.

s0140.literal: Summer, sixth month, on the renshen new moon, Runyan Salt Prefecture was promoted to Baixing Prefecture, Pule Prefecture was reduced to Runyan Salt County, and Jin Prefecture to Jin County.
s0140.idiomatic: Summer, sixth month, on the renshen new moon, Runyan Salt Prefecture was promoted to Baixing Prefecture, Pule Prefecture was reduced to Runyan Salt County, and Jin Prefecture to Jin County.

s0141.literal: The Yellow River overflowed at Taikang, inundating three hundred nineteen thousand eight hundred odd mu of commoner fields; eight thousand nine hundred twenty-eight shi of rent was remitted.
s0141.idiomatic: The Yellow River overflowed at Taikang, inundating 319,800 odd mu of commoner fields; 8,928 shi of rent was remitted.

s0142.literal: The Nalin and other relay-station households suffered famine; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0142.idiomatic: The Nalin and other relay-station households suffered famine; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0143.literal: On jiaxu day Sang Prefecture supervisor Huang Bupeng, Nazhou chief Luo Guangzhai, and Anjun Prefecture chief Bi Guangguo led more than ten thousand households of tribal people to submit.
s0143.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Sang Prefecture supervisor Huang Bupeng, Nazhou chief Luo Guangzhai, and Anjun Prefecture chief Bi Guangguo led more than 10,000 households of tribal people to submit.

s0144.literal: On bingzi day three hundred forty-one artisan households of Baoding including Chu Tong were released as commoners.
s0144.idiomatic: On bingzi day 341 artisan households of Baoding including Chu Tong were released as commoners.

s0145.literal: On gengchen day, following the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat's request, the Guangji Treasury was promoted to a commissionerate, at rank five negative.
s0145.idiomatic: On gengchen day, following the Jiang-Huai branch secretariat's request, the Guangji Treasury was promoted to a commissionerate, at rank five negative.

s0146.literal: Following Jiang-Huai province pingzhang Shabudin's recommendation, associate administrator Wang Juji was rewarded with five hundred ingots of notes for his ability in auditing revenues and grain.
s0146.idiomatic: Following Jiang-Huai province pingzhang Shabudin's recommendation, associate administrator Wang Juji was rewarded with 500 ingots of notes for his ability in auditing revenues and grain.

s0147.literal: Copying the gold-script Buddhist canon consumed three thousand two hundred forty-four liang of gold in all.
s0147.idiomatic: Copying the gold-script Buddhist canon consumed 3,244 liang of gold in all.

s0148.literal: Zengcheng in Guangzhou and Lechang in Shaozhou, having suffered She bandit disorder, had their field rents remitted.
s0148.idiomatic: Zengcheng in Guangzhou and Lechang in Shaozhou, having suffered She bandit disorder, had their field rents remitted.

s0149.literal: Bandits Tang Zhen and others of Hangzhou were executed.
s0149.idiomatic: Bandits Tang Zhen and others of Hangzhou were executed.

s0150.literal: On jichou day Mars encroached upon Fang.
s0150.idiomatic: On jichou day Mars encroached upon Fang.

s0151.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered Yingchang Prefecture to grant one thousand two hundred shi of rice to Prince Yezhilie's retainers.
s0151.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict ordered Yingchang Prefecture to grant 1,200 shi of rice to Prince Yezhilie's retainers.

s0152.literal: On renchen day a separate seal was given to the Jiangxi branch secretariat to facilitate dispatching provincial forces against bandits.
s0152.idiomatic: On renchen day a separate seal was given to the Jiangxi branch secretariat to facilitate dispatching provincial forces against bandits.

s0154.literal: On bingshen day ten thousand guard troops were dispatched to complete the capital walls.
s0154.idiomatic: On bingshen day 10,000 guard troops were dispatched to complete the capital walls.

s0155.literal: On dingyou day Grand Secretary Sariman and Hanlin academician ex officio Ulughadai presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Dingzong.
s0155.idiomatic: On dingyou day Grand Secretary Sariman and Hanlin academician ex officio Ulughadai presented the Veritable Records of Emperor Dingzong.

s0156.literal: On jihai day Yanci in Mizhou and Jiyang suffered great wind and hail, damaging crops; their rent was remitted.
s0156.idiomatic: On jihai day Yanci in Mizhou and Jiyang suffered great wind and hail, damaging crops; their rent was remitted.

s0157.literal: On gengzi day, following Jiangxi province's request, garrison troops from the various provinces were dispatched to suppress bandits.
s0157.idiomatic: On gengzi day, following Jiangxi province's request, garrison troops from the various provinces were dispatched to suppress bandits.

s0158.literal: On xinchou day half of the annual silk levies of Hejian, Baoding, and Pingluan were remitted.
s0158.idiomatic: On xinchou day half of the annual silk levies of Hejian, Baoding, and Pingluan were remitted.

s0159.literal: Wuzhi County in Huaimeng Route and Xiangfu County in Bianliang Route both suffered great flood; eight thousand eight hundred twenty-eight shi of field rent was remitted.
s0159.idiomatic: Wuzhi County in Huaimeng Route and Xiangfu County in Bianliang Route both suffered great flood; 8,828 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0160.literal: Autumn, seventh month: prolonged rain at the Zhongnan and other garrison-farm colonies damaged nineteen thousand six hundred odd mu of crops; their rent was remitted.
s0160.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month: prolonged rain at the Zhongnan and other garrison-farm colonies damaged 19,600 odd mu of crops; their rent was remitted.

s0161.literal: On bingwu day brewing wine at Pingdi and Mang'an granaries was forbidden; violators were sentenced to death.
s0161.idiomatic: On bingwu day brewing wine at Pingdi and Mang'an granaries was forbidden; violators were sentenced to death.

s0162.literal: On wushen day Jiangxi suffered prolonged rain; Gan, Ji, Yuan, Rui, Jianchang, and Fushui all overflowed, and Longxing city was nearly inundated.
s0162.idiomatic: On wushen day Jiangxi suffered prolonged rain; Gan, Ji, Yuan, Rui, Jianchang, and Fushui all overflowed, and Longxing city was nearly inundated.

s0163.literal: On guichou day the Burma branch ministry secretariat was abolished.
s0163.idiomatic: On guichou day the Burma branch ministry secretariat was abolished.

s0164.literal: Jiang-Huai province pingzhang Shabudin, regarding granary officials who stole and embezzled money and grain, requested that following Song law they be tattooed and their wrists cut off; the Emperor said: "This is the Muslim law.
s0164.idiomatic: Jiang-Huai province pingzhang Shabudin, regarding granary officials who stole and embezzled money and grain, requested that following Song law they be tattooed and their wrists cut off; the Emperor said, "This is the Muslim law.

s0166.literal: Dadu Route's annual silk levy was remitted.
s0166.idiomatic: Dadu Route's annual silk levy was remitted.

s0167.literal: On wuwu day more than thirty Maoman of Guizhou caused disorder, raided Shunyuan Route, entered its city, then attacked the Aya stockade, killing and wounding officials; their numbers then grew.
s0167.idiomatic: On wuwu day more than 30 Maoman of Guizhou caused disorder, raided Shunyuan Route, entered its city, then attacked the Aya stockade, killing and wounding officials; their numbers then grew.

s0168.literal: Huguang province ordered the Eight Banners Cai Prefecture and Jun Prefecture ten-thousand-household offices and the Eight Banners Luodian pacification commission to join forces to suppress them.
s0168.idiomatic: Huguang province ordered the Eight Banners Cai Prefecture and Jun Prefecture ten-thousand-household offices and the Eight Banners Luodian pacification commission to join forces to suppress them.

s0169.literal: Fengxiang garrison-farm colony's crops were damaged by prolonged rain; its rent was remitted.
s0169.idiomatic: Fengxiang garrison-farm colony's crops were damaged by prolonged rain; its rent was remitted.

s0170.literal: Bandit Wang Jingzhao of Jianping was executed.
s0170.idiomatic: Bandit Wang Jingzhao of Jianping was executed.

s0171.literal: On xinyou day Mars encroached upon Tianjiang.
s0171.idiomatic: On xinyou day Mars encroached upon Tianjiang.

s0172.literal: On renshen day the imperial carriage halted at Mouse Mountain west.
s0172.idiomatic: On renshen day the imperial carriage halted at Mouse Mountain west.

s0173.literal: On yichou day bandits Xu Ru'an, Sun Weijun, and others of Wuhu were executed.
s0173.idiomatic: On yichou day bandits Xu Ru'an, Sun Weijun, and others of Wuhu were executed.

s0174.literal: On bingyin day eleven district chiefs of Yunnan's Chalilibaiyi district submitted.
s0174.idiomatic: On bingyin day 11 district chiefs of Yunnan's Chalilibaiyi district submitted.

s0175.literal: On dingmao day, following Sangge's recommendation, an edict dispatched Qingyuan Route supervisor Mao Wenbao to search out gold, silver, and other items from the populace dating from Song times; this was soon abolished.
s0175.idiomatic: On dingmao day, following Sangge's recommendation, an edict dispatched Qingyuan Route supervisor Mao Wenbao to search out gold, silver, and other items from the populace dating from Song times; this was soon abolished.

s0176.literal: Leling in Cang Prefecture suffered drought; thirty thousand three hundred fifty-six shi of field rent was remitted.
s0176.idiomatic: Leling in Cang Prefecture suffered drought; 30,356 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0177.literal: The Jiangxia flood overflowed, damaging six thousand four hundred seventy odd mu of crops; its rent was remitted.
s0177.idiomatic: The Jiangxia flood overflowed, damaging 6,470 odd mu of crops; its rent was remitted.

s0178.literal: The Imperial Canal overflowed at Wei County, damaging five thousand eight hundred odd mu of crops; one hundred seventy-five shi of rent was remitted.
s0178.idiomatic: The Imperial Canal overflowed at Wei County, damaging 5,800 odd mu of crops; 175 shi of rent was remitted.

s0179.literal: Autumn, eighth month, on the xinwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0179.idiomatic: Autumn, eighth month, on the xinwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0180.literal: Zhenyang and Qiaguang two counties of the Guangdong circuit were merged as Yingde Prefecture.
s0180.idiomatic: Zhenyang and Qiaguang two counties of the Guangdong circuit were merged as Yingde Prefecture.

s0181.literal: The Qin River overflowed, damaging commoner fields of Jishi; their rent was remitted.
s0181.idiomatic: The Qin River overflowed, damaging commoner fields of Jishi; their rent was remitted.

s0182.literal: All persons were forbidden to obstruct commercial tax collection in Pingyang, Taiyuan, and Datong.
s0182.idiomatic: All persons were forbidden to obstruct commercial tax collection in Pingyang, Taiyuan, and Datong.

s0183.literal: On dingchou day Qingyuan in Guangzhou suffered great flood; its rent was remitted.
s0183.idiomatic: On dingchou day Qingyuan in Guangzhou suffered great flood; its rent was remitted.

s0184.literal: On gengchen day rent and levies of transient commoners in Dadu, Pingluan, Hejian, and Baoding four routes were remitted, along with wine and vinegar taxes.
s0184.idiomatic: On gengchen day rent and levies of transient commoners in Dadu, Pingluan, Hejian, and Baoding four routes were remitted, along with wine and vinegar taxes.

s0185.literal: On dinghai day the Sichuan Southern Circuit pacification commission was again moved to Chongqing Prefecture.
s0185.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Sichuan Southern Circuit pacification commission was again moved to Chongqing Prefecture.

s0186.literal: Because Nan'an, Gan, Jianchang, and Feng Prefecture had all suffered Zhong Mingliang's disorder, their field rents were entirely remitted.
s0186.idiomatic: Because Nan'an, Gan, Jianchang, and Feng Prefecture had all suffered Zhong Mingliang's disorder, their field rents were entirely remitted.

s0187.literal: On guisi day a great earthquake struck; Wuping was worst hit, crushing to death surveillance commission officials, route chief administrator Wang Lian and others, and seven thousand two hundred twenty commoners; four hundred eighty granary storehouses were destroyed, and commoner dwellings were beyond counting.
s0187.idiomatic: On guisi day a great earthquake struck; Wuping was worst hit, crushing to death surveillance commission officials, route chief administrator Wang Lian and others, and 7,220 commoners; 480 granary storehouses were destroyed, and commoner dwellings were beyond counting.

s0188.literal: On jihai day the Emperor, hearing of the Wuping earthquake, fearing Nayan's faction would invade, dispatched pingzhang Temür and privy council official Taluqutai leading five hundred troops to inspect.
s0188.idiomatic: On jihai day the Emperor, hearing of the Wuping earthquake, fearing Nayan's faction would invade, dispatched pingzhang Temür and privy council official Taluqutai leading 500 troops to inspect.

s0189.literal: Autumn, ninth month, on renyin day Hedong-Shanxi Circuit suffered famine; an edict ordered pacification commissioner Arigh Fire to roast grain and relieve them.
s0189.idiomatic: Autumn, ninth month, on renyin day Hedong-Shanxi Circuit suffered famine; an edict ordered pacification commissioner Arigh Fire to roast grain and relieve them.

s0190.literal: On guimao day Jupiter encroached upon Ghost.
s0190.idiomatic: On guimao day Jupiter encroached upon Ghost.

s0191.literal: The prohibition on Han persons' field hunting was strictly enforced.
s0191.idiomatic: The prohibition on Han persons' field hunting was strictly enforced.

s0192.literal: On yisi day princes were forbidden to dispatch monks to build temples and disturb the people.
s0192.idiomatic: On yisi day princes were forbidden to dispatch monks to build temples and disturb the people.

s0193.literal: An edict ordered Hedong-Shanxi Circuit pacification commissioner Arigh Fire to issue two hundred thousand ingots of Datong note capital to purchase grain and relieve famine-stricken commoners.
s0193.idiomatic: An edict ordered Hedong-Shanxi Circuit pacification commissioner Arigh Fire to issue 200,000 ingots of Datong note capital to purchase grain and relieve famine-stricken commoners.

s0194.literal: Pingzhang Chalithemur commanded troops and fought Hedan at Wafa, defeating him utterly.
s0194.idiomatic: Pingzhang Chalithemur commanded troops and fought Hedan at Wafa, defeating him utterly.

s0195.literal: On dingwei day the Imperial Canal breached at Gaotang, inundating commoner fields; officials were ordered to block it.
s0195.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Imperial Canal breached at Gaotang, inundating commoner fields; officials were ordered to block it.

s0196.literal: On wushen day the Wuping earthquake left bandits taking advantage to plunder; the people grew more anxious and fearful.
s0196.idiomatic: On wushen day the Wuping earthquake left bandits taking advantage to plunder; the people grew more anxious and fearful.

s0197.literal: Pingzhang Temür, exercising discretionary authority, remitted rent and levies, abolished commercial taxes, relaxed the wine prohibition, and executed those who robbed;
s0197.idiomatic: Pingzhang Temür, exercising discretionary authority, remitted rent and levies, abolished commercial taxes, relaxed the wine prohibition, and executed those who robbed;

s0198.literal: Eight hundred forty ingots of notes were issued and ten thousand shi of sea-transport grain was diverted to relieve them.
s0198.idiomatic: 840 ingots of notes were issued and 10,000 shi of sea-transport grain was diverted to relieve them.

s0199.literal: Jinzhu Prefecture prefect Saolü presented horses and rain felts as tribute, and said: "Although Jinzhu Prefecture has submitted, many tribal people are still unreconciled.
s0199.idiomatic: Jinzhu Prefecture prefect Saolü presented horses and rain felts as tribute, and said, "Although Jinzhu Prefecture has submitted, many tribal people are still unreconciled.

s0200.literal: Recently, together with Zhao Jian, I induced the surrender of Zhugunong, Guluhua, and more than thirty stockades; I request a county be established, with district magistrates and zongba appointed, employing local people jointly.
s0200.idiomatic: Recently, together with Zhao Jian, I induced the surrender of Zhugunong, Guluhua, and more than 30 stockades; I request a county be established, with district magistrates and zongba appointed, employing local people jointly.
